_comment: RQ3 for Jessica at 0.9 m, replacing 0.8 m, with the pair kept throughout (unit 3 in A, unit 1 in B). At tape 900, squared, live_ranges.py settled on A about 889.3 mm, B about 892.3 mm (mean 890.8), so expected_range_mm at 0 degrees is 891. B minus A is +3.0 mm, so square_offset_mm is 3.0, close to the 2.5 used at 0.3 and 0.6 m. No theta=12 reading was taken yet, so the top of the angle table (913) is estimated from the 10 mm rise at 0.3 m and 16 mm rise at 0.6 m, scaled to this distance; range_tol_mm (15) should absorb a few mm of error, but check it with tools/live_ranges.py at theta=12 early in the run and correct the table if it is off by more than that. The 1.2 m board comfortably covers the full sweep at 0.9 m (about 20 degrees per side before the view runs past its edge, versus 12 needed). Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p9_pair13.json --out data
